newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates close easier at 25.00/26.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates close easier at 25.00/26.00 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed easier on Friday after being traded in an unusually wide range of between 23.50 and 26.75 percent, traders said.
Overnight rates closed at 25.00/26.00 percent compared with Thursday's 26.50 percent ending.
"Tight liquidity continues to dominate the market as considerable funds remain tied up the (central bank's one-week) reverse repo facility," said Zoltan Kalman of Hypo-Bank Hungaria.
He added that a drop is only expected on Tuesday, January 7 when those amounts will hit the market.
